name: Cormorant Garamond
description: Fine, expressive serif. Literary and closest to the roof’s elegance.

name: Instrument Serif
description: Narrow editorial serif. Quiet lettering with a distinctive silhouette.

name: Fraunces
description: Rounder, softer serif. More warmth and visual weight.

name: Alegreya
description: Sturdy literary serif. More informal rhythm and clearer small lettering.

name: Cinzel
description: Engraved Roman lettering. The most overtly historic direction.

name: Manrope
description: Modern sans serif. A restrained counterpart to the detailed symbol.
